title: 6U OpenVPX RFSoC
subtitle: Multi-channel transmit & receive
summary: Integrated RF acquisition, waveform generation and real-time signal processing.
description: The 6U OpenVPX RFSoC is a multichannel transmit and receive platform built around the AMD Zynq UltraScale+ RFSoC XCZU49DR. It combines integrated RF data converters, a processing system and programmable logic to support RF acquisition, waveform generation and real-time digital signal processing.

The platform provides 16 RF input channels and 16 RF output channels, with dedicated DDR4 memory for the processing system and programmable logic. Ethernet, optical connectivity and backplane synchronization interfaces support integration into radar, phased-array and other multichannel RF systems.
highlights: Integrated RF processing: XCZU49DR RFSoC combines RF conversion, embedded processing and programmable logic.
16-channel reception and transmission: Sixteen RF inputs and sixteen RF outputs with balun interfaces.
Dedicated processing memory: Separate 16 GB DDR4 banks for the processing system and programmable logic.
High-speed optical connectivity: Eight GTY lanes connected through a FireFly optical interface at up to 25 Gbps per lane.
Ethernet connectivity: Dual Gigabit Ethernet interfaces and a 10 Gigabit Ethernet interface.
Synchronization support: External reference and synchronization inputs, onboard clock generation and a backplane synchronization bus.
Flexible storage: QSPI flash, EEPROM, microSD card slot and M.2 SSD interface.
System integration and debug: LVDS, USB 2.0, RS-232/485, JTAG, reset and UART-to-USB connectivity.
